metadata.description: From The 4-Hour Workweek to the 2-Minute Work Week: Skills from Tim Ferriss's Book for Claude Code and AI agents. Plus a few modern approaches that lean into AI-first automation

plugins.name: fhww-skills
plugins.description: 26 skills covering The 4-Hour Workweek (dreamlining, fear-setting, deal-framework, eighty-twenty, muse, etc.) plus 4 AI-native 2026 extensions (automate-first, make-it-a-skill, muse-launcher, deep-research) that update the book's outsource-to-a-human reflex to AI-first automation
